item.title: Union County voters approve half-cent sales tax for South Arkansas Regional Hospital
item.description: EL DORADO, Ark. (KTVE/KARD) — Voters in Union County have approved a half-cent sales tax to support South Arkansas Regional Hospital, securing additional funding for the hospital’s operations and long-term stability. The measure passed during Tuesday’s election following months of discussion and community outreach efforts aimed at informing residents about the hospital’s financial needs and its role [...]
